_remove_tags.description: Comma separated list of tags to be removed. Duplicates, invalid and non existing ones are discarded. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

number.description: The order identifier. Can be specified if unique within the organization (for enterprise plans only), default to numeric ID otherwise. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

affiliate_code.description: The affiliate code, if any, to track commissions using any third party services.

autorefresh.description: Save this attribute as 'false' if you want prevent the order to be refreshed automatically at each change (much faster).

place_async.description: Save this attribute as 'true' if you want perform the place asynchronously. Payment errors, if any, will be collected afterwards.

status.description: The order status. One of 'draft' (default), 'pending', 'editing', 'placing', 'placed', 'approved', or 'cancelled'.

payment_status.description: The order payment status. One of 'unpaid' (default), 'authorized', 'partially_authorized', 'paid', 'partially_paid', 'voided', 'partially_voided', 'refunded', 'partially_refunded', or 'free'.

fulfillment_status.description: The order fulfillment status. One of 'unfulfilled' (default), 'in_progress', 'fulfilled', or 'not_required'.

guest.description: Indicates if the order has been placed as guest.

editable.description: Indicates if the order can be edited.

customer_email.description: The email address of the associated customer. When creating or updating an order, this is a shortcut to find or create the associated customer by email.

customer_type.description: The type of the associated customer. One of 'new', or 'returning'.

language_code.description: The preferred language code (ISO 639-1) to be used when communicating with the customer. This can be useful when sending the order to 3rd party marketing tools and CRMs. If the language is supported, the hosted checkout will be localized accordingly.

currency_code.description: The international 3-letter currency code as defined by the ISO 4217 standard, automatically inherited from the order's market.

tax_included.description: Indicates if taxes are included in the order amounts, automatically inherited from the order's price list.

tax_rate.description: The tax rate for this order (if calculated).

freight_taxable.description: Indicates if taxes are applied to shipping costs.

payment_method_taxable.description: Indicates if taxes are applied to payment methods costs.

adjustment_taxable.description: Indicates if taxes are applied to positive adjustments.

gift_card_taxable.description: Indicates if taxes are applied to purchased gift cards.

requires_billing_info.description: Indicates if the billing address associated to this order requires billing info to be present.

country_code.description: The international 2-letter country code as defined by the ISO 3166-1 standard, automatically inherited from the order's shipping or billing addresses.

shipping_country_code_lock.description: The country code that you want the shipping address to be locked to. This can be useful to make sure the shipping address belongs to a given shipping country, e.g. the one selected in a country selector page. Not relevant if order contains only digital products.

coupon_code.description: The coupon code to be used for the order. If valid, it triggers a promotion adding a discount line item to the order.

gift_card_code.description: The gift card code (at least the first 8 characters) to be used for the order. If valid, it uses the gift card balance to pay for the order.

subtotal_amount_cents.description: The sum of all the SKU line items total amounts, in cents.

subtotal_amount_float.description: The sum of all the SKU line items total amounts, float.

formatted_subtotal_amount.description: The sum of all the SKU line items total amounts, formatted.

shipping_amount_cents.description: The sum of all the shipping costs, in cents.

shipping_amount_float.description: The sum of all the shipping costs, float.

formatted_shipping_amount.description: The sum of all the shipping costs, formatted.

payment_method_amount_cents.description: The payment method costs, in cents.

discount_amount_cents.description: The sum of all the discounts applied to the order, in cents (negative amount).

discount_amount_float.description: The sum of all the discounts applied to the order, float.

formatted_discount_amount.description: The sum of all the discounts applied to the order, formatted.

adjustment_amount_cents.description: The sum of all the adjustments applied to the order, in cents.

adjustment_amount_float.description: The sum of all the adjustments applied to the order, float.

formatted_adjustment_amount.description: The sum of all the adjustments applied to the order, formatted.

gift_card_amount_cents.description: The sum of all the gift_cards applied to the order, in cents.

gift_card_amount_float.description: The sum of all the gift_cards applied to the order, float.

formatted_gift_card_amount.description: The sum of all the gift_cards applied to the order, formatted.

total_tax_amount_cents.description: The sum of all the taxes applied to the order, in cents.

total_tax_amount_float.description: The sum of all the taxes applied to the order, float.

formatted_total_tax_amount.description: The sum of all the taxes applied to the order, formatted.

subtotal_tax_amount_cents.description: The taxes applied to the order's subtotal, in cents.

subtotal_tax_amount_float.description: The taxes applied to the order's subtotal, float.

formatted_subtotal_tax_amount.description: The taxes applied to the order's subtotal, formatted.

shipping_tax_amount_cents.description: The taxes applied to the order's shipping costs, in cents.

shipping_tax_amount_float.description: The taxes applied to the order's shipping costs, float.

formatted_shipping_tax_amount.description: The taxes applied to the order's shipping costs, formatted.

payment_method_tax_amount_cents.description: The taxes applied to the order's payment method costs, in cents.

payment_method_tax_amount_float.description: The taxes applied to the order's payment method costs, float.

formatted_payment_method_tax_amount.description: The taxes applied to the order's payment method costs, formatted.

adjustment_tax_amount_cents.description: The taxes applied to the order adjustments, in cents.

adjustment_tax_amount_float.description: The taxes applied to the order adjustments, float.

formatted_adjustment_tax_amount.description: The taxes applied to the order adjustments, formatted.

total_amount_cents.description: The order's total amount, in cents.

total_taxable_amount_cents.description: The order's total taxable amount, in cents (without discounts).

total_taxable_amount_float.description: The order's total taxable amount, float.

formatted_total_taxable_amount.description: The order's total taxable amount, formatted.

subtotal_taxable_amount_cents.description: The order's subtotal taxable amount, in cents (equal to subtotal_amount_cents when prices don't include taxes).

subtotal_taxable_amount_float.description: The order's subtotal taxable amount, float.

formatted_subtotal_taxable_amount.description: The order's subtotal taxable amount, formatted.

shipping_taxable_amount_cents.description: The order's shipping taxable amount, in cents (equal to shipping_amount_cents when prices don't include taxes).

shipping_taxable_amount_float.description: The order's shipping taxable amount, float.

formatted_shipping_taxable_amount.description: The order's shipping taxable amount, formatted.

payment_method_taxable_amount_cents.description: The order's payment method taxable amount, in cents (equal to payment_method_amount_cents when prices don't include taxes).

payment_method_taxable_amount_float.description: The order's payment method taxable amount, float.

formatted_payment_method_taxable_amount.description: The order's payment method taxable amount, formatted.

adjustment_taxable_amount_cents.description: The order's adjustment taxable amount, in cents (equal to discount_adjustment_cents when prices don't include taxes).

adjustment_taxable_amount_float.description: The order's adjustment taxable amount, float.

formatted_adjustment_taxable_amount.description: The order's adjustment taxable amount, formatted.

total_amount_with_taxes_cents.description: The order's total amount (when prices include taxes) or the order's total + taxes amount (when prices don't include taxes, e.g. US Markets or B2B).

total_amount_with_taxes_float.description: The order's total amount with taxes, float.

_archive.description: Send this attribute if you want to archive the order.

_unarchive.description: Send this attribute if you want to unarchive the order.

_pending.description: Send this attribute if you want to move a draft or placing order to pending. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_place.description: Send this attribute if you want to place the order.

_cancel.description: Send this attribute if you want to cancel a placed order. The order's authorization will be automatically voided.

_approve.description: Send this attribute if you want to approve a placed order. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_approve_and_capture.description: Send this attribute if you want to approve and capture a placed order. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_authorize.description: Send this attribute if you want to authorize the order's payment source.

_authorization_amount_cents.description: Send this attribute as a value in cents if you want to overwrite the amount to be authorized.

_capture.description: Send this attribute if you want to capture an authorized order. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_refund.description: Send this attribute if you want to refund a captured order. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_fulfill.description: Send this attribute if you want to mark as fulfilled the order (shipments must be cancelled, shipped or delivered, alternatively order must be approved). Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_update_taxes.description: Send this attribute if you want to force tax calculation for this order (a tax calculator must be associated to the order's market).

_nullify_payment_source.description: Send this attribute if you want to nullify the payment source for this order.

_fix_payment_source.description: Send this attribute if you want to set the payment source associated with the last succeeded authorization. At the end of the fix the order should be placed and authorized and ready to be approved. A tentative to fix the payment source is done before approval automatically. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_billing_address_clone_id.description: The id of the address that you want to clone to create the order's billing address.

_shipping_address_clone_id.description: The id of the address that you want to clone to create the order's shipping address.

_customer_payment_source_id.description: The id of the customer payment source (i.e. credit card) that you want to use as the order's payment source.

_shipping_address_same_as_billing.description: Send this attribute if you want the shipping address to be cloned from the order's billing address.

_billing_address_same_as_shipping.description: Send this attribute if you want the billing address to be cloned from the order's shipping address.

_commit_invoice.description: Send this attribute if you want commit the sales tax invoice to the associated tax calculator (currently supported by Avalara).

_refund_invoice.description: Send this attribute if you want refund the sales tax invoice to the associated tax calculator (currently supported by Avalara).

_save_payment_source_to_customer_wallet.description: Send this attribute if you want the order's payment source to be saved in the customer's wallet as a customer payment source.

_save_shipping_address_to_customer_addre.description: Send this attribute if you want the order's shipping address to be saved in the customer's address book as a customer address.

_save_billing_address_to_customer_addres.description: Send this attribute if you want the order's billing address to be saved in the customer's address book as a customer address.

_refresh.description: Send this attribute if you want to manually refresh the order.

_validate.description: Send this attribute if you want to trigger the external validation for the order.

_create_subscriptions.description: Send this attribute upon/after placing the order if you want to create order subscriptions from the line items that have a frequency.

_start_editing.description: Send this attribute if you want to edit the order after it is placed. Remember you cannot exceed the original total amount. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_stop_editing.description: Send this attribute to stop the editing for the order and return back to placed status. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_add_tags.description: Comma separated list of tags to be added. Duplicates, invalid and non existing ones are discarded. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

_remove_tags.description: Comma separated list of tags to be removed. Duplicates, invalid and non existing ones are discarded. Cannot be passed by sales channels.

gtm_id_test.description: The organization's Google Tag Manager ID for test.

api_auth_redirect.description: Enables the redirect on the new Auth API.

api_rules_engine.description: Enables the rules engine for flex promotions and price list rules.

api_rules_engine_max_conditions_size.description: The fallback maximum number of conditions within a rules payload on a ruleable object, default is 150.

api_rules_engine_max_rules_size.description: The fallback maximum number of rules within a rules payload on a ruleable object, default is 15.

api_new_auth.description: Forces the usage of the new Authentication API.

api_purge_single_resource.description: Enables the purge of cached single resources when list is purged.

api_max_regex_length.description: The maximum length for the regular expressions, default is 5000.

addresses_avs_check.description: Indicates if AVS checking will be enforced during payment workflow by passing specific attributes, default is true.

addresses_phone_required.description: Indicates if the phone attribute is required for addresses, default is true.

orders_sales_channel_guest_only.description: Indicates if a sales channel application without customer can read and update just guest orders.

orders_min_rebuild_shipments_lapse.description: The minimum lapse in fraction of seconds to be observed between two consecutive shipments rebuilt. If shipments rebuilt is triggered within the minimum lapse, the update is performed, but no rebuilt is done.

orders_min_refresh_lapse.description: The minimum lapse in fraction of seconds to be observed between two consecutive order refreshes. If refresh is triggered within the minimum lapse, the update is performed, but no order refresh is done.

orders_autorefresh_cutoff_test.description: The maximum number line items allowed for a test order before disabling the autorefresh option.

orders_autorefresh_cutoff_live.description: The maximum number line items allowed for a live order before disabling the autorefresh option.

orders_number_editable_test.description: Enables orders number editing as a string in test (for enterprise plans only).

orders_number_editable_live.description: Enables orders number editing as a string in live (for enterprise plans only).

orders_number_as_reference.description: Enables to use the order number as payment reference on supported gateways.

orders_invalid_coupon_errors.description: Enables raising of API errors in case the provided coupon code is invalid, default is true.

orders_invalid_gift_card_errors.description: Enables raising of API errors in case the provided gift card code is invalid, default is true.

orders_validate_shipping_stock.description: Enables the validation of the generated stock line items and stock transfers before placing the order, default is false.

bundles_max_items_count.description: The maximum number of SKUs allowed for bundles, default is 10.

coupons_min_code_length.description: The minimum length for coupon code, default is 8.

coupons_max_code_length.description: The maximum length for coupon code, default is 40.

gift_cards_exact_code_matching.description: Enables matching the gift card code by its exact value, instead of by its first charachters, default is false.

gift_cards_min_code_length.description: The minimum length for gift card code, default is 8.

gift_cards_max_code_length.description: The maximum length for gift card code, default is 40.

cleanups_max_concurrent_count.description: The maximum number of concurrent cleanups allowed for your organization, default is 10.

exports_max_concurrent_count.description: The maximum number of concurrent exports allowed for your organization, default is 10.

imports_max_concurrent_count.description: The maximum number of concurrent imports allowed for your organization, default is 10.

imports_purge_cache.description: Enables purging of cached resources upon succeeded imports.

imports_skip_errors.description: Disables the interruption of the import in case its errors exceeds the 10% threshold, default is false.

inventory_models_max_stock_locations_cut.description: The maximum number for stock locations cutoff, default is 10.

promotions_max_concurrent_count.description: The maximum number of active concurrent promotions allowed for your organization, default is 10.

promotions_max_conditions_size.description: The maximum number of conditions within a rules payload on a promotion object, default is 150.

promotions_max_rules_size.description: The maximum number of rules within a rules payload on a promotion object, default is 15.

price_lists_max_conditions_size.description: The maximum number of conditions within a rules payload on a price list object, default is 150.

price_lists_max_rules_size.description: The maximum number of rules within a rules payload on a price list object, default is 15.

imports_trigger_webhooks.description: Enables triggering of webhooks during imports, default is false.

discount_engines_enabled.description: Enables the use of an external discount engine in place of the standard one, default is false.

discount_engines_errors.description: Enables raising of API errors in case of discount engine failure, default is false.

tags_max_name_length.description: The maximum length for the tag name, default is 25.

tags_max_allowed_number.description: The maximum allowed number of tags for each resource, default is 10.

tax_calculators_errors.description: Enables raising of API errors in case of tax calculation failure, default is false.

external_promotions_errors.description: Enables raising of API errors in case of external promotion failure, default is false.

external_prices_errors.description: Enables raising of API errors in case of external price failure, default is true.

eel_pfc.description: When shipping outside the US, you need to provide either an Exemption and Exclusion Legend (EEL) code or a Proof of Filing Citation (PFC). Which you need is based on the value of the goods being shipped. Value can be one of "EEL" o "PFC".

contents_type.description: The type of item you are sending.

contents_explanation.description: If you specify 'other' in the 'contents_type' attribute, you must supply a brief description in this attribute.

customs_certify.description: Indicates if the provided information is accurate.

customs_signer.description: This is the name of the person who is certifying that the information provided on the customs form is accurate. Use a name of the person in your organization who is responsible for this.

non_delivery_option.description: In case the shipment cannot be delivered, this option tells the carrier what you want to happen to the parcel. You can pass either 'return', or 'abandon'. The value defaults to 'return'. If you pass 'abandon', you will not receive the parcel back if it cannot be delivered.

restriction_type.description: Describes if your parcel requires any special treatment or quarantine when entering the country. Can be one of 'none', 'other', 'quarantine', or 'sanitary_phytosanitary_inspection'.

restriction_comments.description: If you specify 'other' in the restriction type, you must supply a brief description of what is required.

customs_info_required.description: Indicates if the parcel requires customs info to get the shipping rates.

shipping_label_url.description: The shipping label url, ready to be downloaded and printed.

shipping_label_file_type.description: The shipping label file type. One of 'application/pdf', 'application/zpl', 'application/epl2', or 'image/png'.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number associated to this parcel.

tracking_status.description: The tracking status for this parcel, automatically updated in real time by the shipping carrier.

tracking_status_detail.description: Additional information about the tracking status, automatically updated in real time by the shipping carrier.

tracking_status_updated_at.description: Time at which the parcel's tracking status was last updated.

tracking_details.description: The parcel's full tracking history, automatically updated in real time by the shipping carrier.

carrier_weight_oz.description: The weight of the parcel as measured by the carrier in ounces (if available).

signed_by.description: The name of the person who signed for the parcel (if available).

delivery_confirmation.description: The type of delivery confirmation option upon delivery.
